summary: Interpretability extraction of centred Delta-tilde SVD features (top-32 V/S/U per GPT-2 block), decoded to vocab via W_U and to corpus via |U|, with heuristic coherence labels. Reuses cycle 218 pipeline, matches the notebook loader contract at notebooks/bump_features_explore.py.
strengths: Filenames use cycle_235_t1_* matching the notebook loader (cycle:03d format).
V_top32 stored as (768, 32) per loader expectation at L296.
Token-stream grouping yields exact 102400 real tokens, no padding.
delta_out computed in 4096-row chunks, reusing verified cycle 218 pattern.
SVD explicitly on CPU to avoid MPS memory / device issues.
Variance-explained denominator uses FULL singular spectrum S, not just top-32.
Cross-check against cycle 218 vh_top20 is a soft sanity print, not a hard assert.
Fallback tree covers wikitext train unavailability, SVD OOM (svd_lowrank), tokenizer cache, and threshold misfire (raw counts logged).
concerns: Wikitext-2 train split assumed available; fallback to val split with warning is correct but should be verified at runtime.
Coherence heuristic thresholds (40/20) are rough; acknowledged, with raw counts logged for re-labelling.
wte @ v projection is correct for GPT-2 because wte is tied to lm_head (W_U = W_E^T here).
Record dict must include block: l so the summary counts rec['block'] == l works. Minor — call out during execute.
notes: Verdict thresholds pre-registered: CONFIRMED if >=5 coherent dirs in >=6/12 blocks; REFUTED if <2 in ALL 12 blocks; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. Execute step should ensure each decoded record carries a 'block' key.
